description.value: The Best Western Sicamous Inn sits on the Trans-Canada Highway in Sicamous, a gateway town known as the Houseboat Capital of Canada, with Shuswap Lake and Mara Lake just minutes away. The property has earned the TripAdvisor Award of Excellence and offers pet-friendly rooms with kitchenette options and jetted tubs. The Shuswap region surrounding Sicamous provides year-round outdoor recreation, making this a natural overnight stop for cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor.
